g1.label: 1. A small town in ___
g1.why: The text says Jake lives in a small town in Ohio.

g2.label: 2. Gets up at half past ___
g2.why: The text says Jake gets up at half past six on school days.

g3.label: 3. Usually ___ with milk
g3.why: The text says breakfast is usually cereal with milk and orange juice.

g4.label: 4. Goes there by ___
g4.why: The text says Jake goes to school by bus with his friends.

g5.label: 5. Football ___
g5.why: The text says Jake has football practice twice a week.

g6.label: 6. The family eats ___ together
g6.why: The text says the family eats dinner together at six.

g7.label: 7. Does his ___
g7.why: The text says Jake does his homework after dinner.

g8.label: 8. Goes to ___ at half past nine
g8.why: The text says Jake goes to bed at half past nine.

g1.label: 1. Jake ___ up every morning
g1.why: Present simple: he/she/it takes -s — 'Jake gets up'.

g2.label: 2. His sister ___ to a different school

g3.label: 3. ___ your brother play basketball?
g3.why: Questions with he/she/it start with 'Does' + infinitive.

g6.label: 6. ___ your friends live near the school?
g6.why: Questions with plural 'they/your friends' start with 'Do'.

g8.label: 8. Last Saturday, Jake ___ to a baseball game
g8.why: Review from 8c-arriving-northeast: the simple past of 'go' is 'went'.

g1.label: 1. Jake ___ late for school
g1.why: With 'to be', the adverb comes after it: 'is never late'.

g2.label: 2. He ___ his homework
g2.why: With a normal verb, the adverb comes before it: 'always does'.

g3.label: 3. They ___ to the gym
g3.why: Word order: adverb + main verb — 'sometimes go'.

g6.label: 6. My dad ___ coffee
g6.why: Before the main verb: 'never drinks' — no extra 'does' needed.

g7.label: 7. I ___ my teeth twice a day

g8.label: 8. School ___ open on Saturdays
g8.why: With 'to be', the adverb follows: 'is never open'.
